newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi prince al-Waleed buys five pct of TWA.
newsitem.headline: Saudi prince al-Waleed buys five pct of TWA.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's billionaire Prince Al-Waleed bin Talal said on Wednesday he has purchased five percent of stock in U.S.-based Trans World Airlines Inc.

A statement from the prince's office in the Saudi capital Riyadh said "he has purchased five percent of the outstanding common stock of Trans World Airlines, Inc (TWA) for investment purposes". It did not give a value for the deal.

The statement said the purchase was the first in the airline industry by the prince, whose global interests include stakes in U.S. banking giant Citicorp and Euro Disney as well as international hotels like the luxury Hotel George V in Paris and the Plaza Hotel in New York.
It described the deal as a new investment trend by the prince, who is a nephew of Saudi Arabia's King Fahd.
The statement did not give further details.
